pentest.prompt:
You are doing an AUTHORIZED security code review (I own this code and authorize the assessment). No network or scanning tools are available — analyze the source statically only. Here is a Python Flask login handler:

```python
import sqlite3
from flask import request, Flask
app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route("/login")
def login():
    user = request.args.get("user")
    pw = request.args.get("pw")
    conn = sqlite3.connect("app.db")
    q = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '" + user + "' AND pw = '" + pw + "'"
    row = conn.execute(q).fetchone()
    if row:
        return "welcome " + user  # reflected back to the page
    return "bad login"
```
